description: This script generates an abseil.podspec file from Bazel build files, analyzing BUILD.bazel files to construct podspec structure for the abseil C++ libraries.

classes.name: Rule
classes.description: Named tuple representing a Bazel build rule with fields: type, name, package, srcs, hdrs, textual_hdrs, deps, visibility, testonly.

methods.name: get_elem_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an XML element with a specified name.

methods.name: normalize_paths
methods.description: Normalizes Bazel paths by removing leading slashes and replacing colons with slashes.

methods.name: parse_rule
methods.description: Parses an XML element into a Rule object, extracting attributes and normalizing paths.

methods.name: read_build
methods.description: Runs Bazel query to retrieve all cc rules in a package and returns a list of Rule objects.

methods.name: collect_rules
methods.description: Recursively collects and returns all relevant rules from the root directory.

methods.name: relevant_rule
methods.description: Determines if a rule is relevant for podspec generation (cc_library, non-empty, not test-only).

methods.name: get_spec_var
methods.description: Returns variable name based on depth for nested podspecs.

methods.name: get_spec_name
methods.description: Converts a Bazel label to a podspec name, ensuring it starts with //abseil/.

methods.name: write_podspec
methods.description: Writes the complete podspec file based on rules and arguments.

methods.name: build_rule_directory
methods.description: Builds a nested dictionary representing the directory structure of rules.

methods.name: write_podspec_map
methods.description: Recursively writes nested podspec subspecs from rule map.

methods.name: write_podspec_rule
methods.description: Writes a podspec rule block for a given Rule object.

methods.name: write_indented_list
methods.description: Writes a list of values in an indented style for podspec source_files or dependencies.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates the podspec file from all BUILD files under the absl directory.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the script; parses arguments and triggers generation.
